title: Write features/daw/export_sidecars.feature, sync scenario and the CLI runner (red)
description:
## Intent
Specs first for M2.

## Scope
- `features/daw/export_sidecars.feature`: every scenario of the three M2 stories.
- `features/daw/STEPS.md`: new CLI steps (`When I run {string}`, `Then the output says {string}`, `Then the command fails with {string}`, file-exists/unchanged steps).
- Runner: `crates/apricity-cli/tests/daw_cli.rs` (cucumber-rs, harness = false) running the built `apricity` binary against a temp dir with generated fixture audio (`scripts/daw-fixture-audio.py` digests) and fixture manifests.
- `features/sync/sync.feature`: scenario "Sidecars never sync" (steps in the existing sync runner).

## Verify
`safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-cli --test daw_cli` fails on the new scenarios for the right reason.

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.
